{{Weapon infobox | type = Dagger | level = 80 | salvage = none | rarity = Legendary | prefix = selectable | uslot = Superior Sigil of Fire | bound = account use | skin = Incinerator (skin); Spark (skin); Usoku's Needle (skin); Spark Experiment (skin) | id = 30687 | gallery2 = Incinerator stowed.jpg | gallery2-text = Stowed. | gallery3 = Incinerator footfalls.jpg | gallery3-text = Earth cracking lava footfalls. }} [[Incinerator]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] dagger crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|"I know this isn't the path you'd have chosen for yourself — but the [[Flame Legion]] isn't just your home now; It is my gift to you. Keep this dagger close and never forget who you are: Nonius Ragesinger."}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Spark (weapon) | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Incinerator | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[Incinerator]] is a dagger whose blade is made of a flame like that of a welding torch. The blade also emits light when drawn, illuminating the area around the user in dark areas. ;Aura * The arm wielding Incinerator is on fire. ;Draw/Stow effects * When drawn, fire twirls around the user and a furnace-like sound plays. ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind footprints that looks like the ground is cracking from lava. ;Kill animations * Enemies killed by Incinerator will display burning death animations. ;Skill effects * Attacks cause a cosmetic burst of flame on the target. * Attacks with projectiles will use a unique sound. * Ranged skills will throw Incinerator instead of the default projectile. This effect changes the following skills: ** {{spellbreaker}} [[Spellbreaker]]: [[Throw Rock]] (downed skill). ** {{r}} [[Ranger]]: [[Crippling Talon]] and [[Throw Dirt]] (downed skill). *** {{Soulbeast}} [[Soulbeast]]: Any projectile from Soulbeast pet skills such as [[Narcotic Spores (soulbeast)|Narcotic Spores]]. ** {{t}} [[Thief]]: [[Dancing Dagger]], [[Death Blossom]]'s whirl finishers, [[Shadow Shot]], projectiles acquired through [[Steal]], and [[Trail of Knives]]. ** {{n}} [[Necromancer]]: [[Deathly Swarm]], [[Dhuumfire (death shroud skill)|Dhuumfire]], [[Dark Path]] and [[Life Blast]]. *** {{harbinger}} [[Harbinger]]: [[Tainted Bolts]] and [[Dark Barrage]]. ** {{e}} [[Elementalist]]: [[Dragon's Claw]] and [[Vapor Blade]]. *** {{tempest}} [[Tempest]]: [[Overload Fire]]'s whirl finishers. ** {{virtuoso}} [[Virtuoso]]: [[Flying Cutter]], [[Bladecall]], [[Bladesong Harmony]], [[Bladesong Sorrow]], and [[Bladesong Dissonance]]. {{anomaly|{{n}} [[Necromancer]]: [[Necrotic Bite]] loses the Bite animation.}} === Gallery === File:Incinerator concept art.jpg|Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]].
